note: Hand-maintained by Claude after each metered Workflow batch finishes — not a live billing meter. A batch that gets stopped mid-run or finished by hand (no clean final token report) is logged at $0 with an honest note rather than an invented number. Check the Anthropic Console for the authoritative figure.

entries.label: Gap acknowledged, 2026-08-21 to 2026-08-23 — Modules 04, 05, 06 fully built, Module 07 opened
entries.outcome: This log went stale for two days. Real batches ran for all of these modules, including several that stalled and were finished by hand — several of those specific runs were superseded/stopped mid-flight rather than finishing normally, and don't have a clean final token count to report. entries.label: Batch run — Module 07 Concepts 1-5
entries.outcome: Concept 1's write stage stalled on a throttled retry and was finished by hand; Concepts 2 and 4 also hit write-stage retries, caught and finished manually; Concepts 3 and 5 built cleanly.

entries.label: Batch run — Module 07 Concept 6, then stopped
entries.outcome: Concept 6 built cleanly end-to-end. Concept 7's research stage returned placeholder/test content instead of real research (a genuine bug, not a timeout) and its write stage was retrying against that garbage — stopped before it could burn further budget, finished Concept 7 by hand with a freshly-researched and independently-verified worked example. No clean final token total for this stopped run.
